title: High-Protein, Lower-Fat Board
seo_title: High-Protein Charcuterie Board: Lean Meats & Shopping List
description: A high-protein, lower-fat charcuterie board for 6: Swiss, Parmesan, part-skim mozzarella, bresaola, smoked turkey, shrimp, eggs, snap peas and cherry tomatoes.
hook: Lean meats, seafood and hard cheeses: the board for people counting protein as well as carbs.
why: The swaps here are simple: bresaola instead of salami, smoked turkey instead of prosciutto, shrimp and eggs for extra protein, and Swiss, Parmesan and part-skim mozzarella for lighter cheese.
Snap peas, cucumbers and cherry tomatoes are the dippers, and pickles, mustard, lemon and black pepper keep it full of flavor. About 54 g of protein and 8 g net carbs per serving.

timeline.what: Take out the Swiss and parmesan.
Take out the turkey and bresaola; roll the turkey.
Build the board; keep the shrimp cold.

faq.a: Bresaola (air-dried beef) and smoked turkey breast are among the leanest. Salami and prosciutto have more fat.

faq.q: Which cheeses are highest in protein?
faq.a: Hard cheeses like Parmesan and Swiss, and part-skim mozzarella, have the most protein for their calories.
About 54 g of protein per serving for 6, from the book's nutrition breakdown.
